purpose: Calibration and held-out RD screening only; never execute dataset scripts
fetch_status: Manifest only; no datasets fetched in phases 1 or 2
revision_policy: Resolve and record a commit SHA before fetching any selected file. Record URL, file SHA256, revision, license text and selected row IDs in provenance.json. Fetch only selected parquet/JSON files, never a repository snapshot.
split_policy: Disjoint source row/article IDs for calibration and held-out; preserve conversations and tool schemas; deduplicate text SHA256 across all slices. Parallel translations must use disjoint sentence IDs across splits. Export UTF-8 text; record formatting and row IDs. Use validation/test splits below only as RD text, never claim benchmark accuracy.
export_policy: Export calibration.json and heldout.json with slices mapping each name to absolute UTF-8 file paths. Export slice_roles.json from this manifest. Equal 8192-token calibration budgets per slice, two 4096-token halves; held-out 512 tokens/slice. Never repeat text to meet quota; extend unique source rows when under target. Include heldout_only domains only in heldout.json. Retain provenance and deduplicate across all slices/splits/translations. Hash-group IDs before token truncation; no conversation/article may span halves when practical. Counts/stability may require more calibration.

sources.selection: A bounded subset of train_sft messages and test_sft messages; include both user and assistant turns
sources.download_policy: Selected parquet shard only if <200 MB; otherwise stream a bounded row export and count actual received bytes

sources.selection: full configuration; calibration train, heldout validation/test; text, code and test_list
main; calibration train, heldout test; question and answer
Bounded rows including tool schemas, assistant calls, JSON arguments and tool results; deterministic disjoint conversation IDs

sources.split: Use auxiliary/dev/validation where available, otherwise deterministic disjoint test row IDs; render question, choices and answer text. Small domain probes, not clinical/legal/financial validation.

sources.selection: Selected language files/configurations only; dev for calibration, devtest heldout. This repository is gated: owner must accept conditions; do not bypass. An updated source is openlanguagedata/flores_plus; changing source requires recording its revision/license and exact language mapping.

sources.license: ODC-BY-1.0; retain database attribution (verify pinned card)
sources.selection: Chinese language, benign general conversations; split by conversation_hash and turn_identifier group hash; preserve roles. Exclude cold topics and medical/legal PII.

sources.license: MIT dataset; retain underlying repository attribution for code excerpts
sources.selection: Small selected ticks parquet shard below 200 MB; preserve assistant/terminal commands/results as inert text; group by repository/task instance_id across splits. Never execute commands.

sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 and applicable GFDL; record article revision, URL, contributors link and license per extract
sources.selection: Owner-curated bounded article revision exports; no dump download. Cold topics limited to archaeology, regional folk customs and obscure historical trivia; exclude medicine/law/finance/science/code/math and safety content even when under cold categories. Use a monolingual general_reference_en or general_reference_zh matching each cold slice; never divide Chinese cold saliency by an English reference. Each general reference covers broad daily syntax/topic mix and excludes cold article IDs. Split by article ID, not paragraph; disjoint reference and cold articles.

sources.split: held-out only; no calibration rows from these subjects; preserve source row IDs and use disjoint source shards from other subjects

license_policy: Retain each source license and attribution alongside local exports. Check cards at pinned revisions before fetching. Do not redistribute raw corpus in the model artifact.

contrastive_policy.normalization: REAP divided by per-layer expert mean separately per slice/half for hot protection; raw hot REAP retained for RD layer sensitivity
contrastive_policy.general_reference: general_reference_en / general_reference_zh, matched by cold slice language suffix
contrastive_policy.never_routed: keep by default; hard-protected during fallback too
contrastive_policy.cold_languages: English/Chinese only; low-resource languages remain hot/protected, never cold
contrastive_policy.language_balance: Each cold English or Chinese slice uses its same-language reference with equal token budgets; audit topic contamination before calibration.
